name: What is the process for designing and installing custom stonework?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for designing and installing custom stonework?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision, needs, and budget. Next, our design team develops detailed plans and material recommendations, providing you with renderings or samples. Once the design is approved, we handle all necessary permits. The installation phase involves site preparation, precise stone cutting and placement, and finishing touches. Throughout the project, we maintain clear communication and ensure quality control, culminating in a final walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction with the custom stonework.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, design, permit acquisition, site preparation, installation, and a final walkthrough to ensure satisfaction.
